literal_meaning: কান (ear) পাতা (to lend or pay attention) দায় (difficult or burdensome)
figurative_meaning_bn: শোনার পক্ষে অসহ্য; কিছুই শোনা যাচ্ছে না এমন অবস্থা
figurative_meaning_en: Unbearable to listen to; a situation where nothing can be heard
example_sentences_in_bangla: উচ্চ আওয়াজের কারণে বক্তৃতা শোনা কান পাতা দায় হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The market's clamor makes it impossible to listen.
Due to the loud noise, listening to the speech has become unbearable.
note: The idiom draws from the idea of 'lending an ear' being a burden in noisy environments, common in Bengali expressive language.
